title: Giants RB Cam Skattebo credits redeeming effort against Texans to mindset shift

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants RB Cam Skattebo credits redeeming effort against Texans to mindset shift
sources.description: After seeing his playing time dramatically reduced in Week 6, Giants running back Cam Skattebo more than earned his starting spot back against the Houston Texans.
